description: This is a unit test class for the LeaveTypeDao class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, specifically testing CRUD operations, search functionality, and behavior of LeaveType entities.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveTypeDao's functionality, including creating, retrieving, deleting, undeleting, and searching leave types in the OrangeHRM plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new LeaveTypeDao instance and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of leave types and compares the result with expected fixture data.

methods.name: _getLeaveTypeObjectWithValues
methods.description: Creates and returns a LeaveType object with preset name 'Special' and deleted status false.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests saving a LeaveType object and asserts that the returned object has ID 1.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeCheckSavedType
methods.description: Verifies that a saved LeaveType has the correct name and deletion status.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests deletion of leave types by IDs and verifies the number of affected records.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Checks that a LeaveType marked as deleted has its 'isDeleted' property set to true.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies the list of deleted leave types and their IDs.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures all returned leave types from getDeletedLeaveTypeList are instances of LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Asserts the count of deleted leave types.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Ensures that certain IDs and names are not present in the deleted leave type list.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks the specific IDs and names in the list of deleted leave types, verifying order and data correctness.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests undeleting leave types by ID, verifying the returned object and its properties.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Verifies that the undeleted LeaveType has 'isDeleted' as false and correct ID.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Tests that the list of leave types reflects the undeletion, including the presence of specific data.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of LeaveType objects by name, expecting correct object or null.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameValues
methods.description: Verifies the ID and name of the LeaveType retrieved by name.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectType
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of LeaveType objects by ID, both active and deleted types.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectWrongArgument
methods.description: Checks that invalid ID returns null.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdValues
methods.description: Verifies the properties of LeaveType fetched by ID.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures all leave types returned are instances of LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Asserts the total number of leave types returned.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Verifies that specific IDs and names are not included in the list.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks the IDs and names of leave types in sorted order.

methods.name: _compareLeaveTypes
methods.description: Helper method to compare two arrays of LeaveType objects.

methods.name: _compareLeaveType
methods.description: Helper method to compare two LeaveType objects, asserting their properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Tests the count of leave types matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveType
methods.description: Tests searching leave types with default filter parameters, verifying correct list and data.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeSearchByName
methods.description: Tests searching leave types filtered by specific name.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit applied to the number of returned leave types.
